name: Jean-Adolphe Beaucé

summary.text: Jean-Adolphe Beaucé was a French battle-scene painter. He followed the French army on campaign from 1843 onwards in North Africa, the Middle East and Mexico.
summary.title: Jean-Adolphe Beaucé
